rationale: While MiniLM-L-6-v2 significantly improves Track B Hit@1 (+13.5pp) and MRR (+7.8pp), it causes coverage regression (Hit@5 drops from 0.7308 to 0.7115) and incurs a 14x+ CPU latency penalty. TinyBERT operates within acceptable latency (2.3x) but also drops Hit@5/Recall@5 and fails to resolve technical failures. Coverage-preserving and margin-gated strategies reduce regressions but still fail to achieve a safe net improvement over the robust Dense + BM25 RRF baseline without sacrificing latency.
